checks: Additive migration preserves existing review ID, text, score and missing source
Favorites require authentication and cannot be written for another customer
Favorites are private and cannot be deleted by another customer
Favorites reject unavailable providers, duplicate rows and reassignment
Favorites owner can remove a saved provider
Catalog has product definitions and no invented provider offerings
Only store owner can change offerings, including ownerless profile
Variant must belong to the offered service
Slots use Istanbul timezone, service duration and weekly hours
Wrong service region and past day expose no slots
Time off closes all slots
Inactive and unapproved providers cannot be purchased
Client price manipulation rejected before reservation
Two separate concurrent transactions: exactly one can reserve the same slot
Overlapping start times blocked, adjacent appointment stays available
10 percent commission stored separately in minor units
Legacy assignment cannot bypass a held commerce slot
Legacy reservation blocks its full day until duration is reconciled
RLS isolates customer, assigned provider, other provider and admin
Payment session has a single initializer and no public token access
Verified payment confirms once and duplicate callback is idempotent
Only assigned provider advances paid order, completion requires customer code
Only completed order owner can review; real rating aggregated
Completion payout has one durable external-operation claim
Hold idempotency returns the same order without extending expiry
Expired holds immediately stop blocking, before cron cleanup
Late paid callback becomes REFUND_PENDING and never steals a rebooked slot
Refund is only final after verified processor completion and cannot be claimed twice
Failed payment releases the slot
Expiry cleanup is restricted and idempotent
Admin finance RPC rejects customers, providers and guests
Server financial totals separate successful GMV, commission, refunds and sandbox environment
Provider finance is scoped and reports processor costs separately
Participant finance has no token, URL, external transaction ID or completion code
Saved address RLS prevents spoofed owner and cross-customer reads or deletes
Order and payment changes write redacted audit records atomically
Real order transitions notify both participants with safe order links
Users cannot forge commerce notifications or edit notification content
Captured payment date survives settlement updates
Admin refund requests cannot invent payment success or refund an unpaid order
Historical refund and payout share one durable claim; no duplicate external operation
Catalog definitions and variants are admin-only and never fabricate provider prices
Customer cannot self-promote by profile insert or role update
Role and commission changes create database audit evidence
Order retains included/excluded scope when catalogue changes
Provider cannot forge rating counts, approval or marketplace payout credentials
Review eligibility: guest has no private RPC access
Review eligibility: customer without service has no action or write permission
Review eligibility: completed legacy service has a specific source and one review
Review eligibility: second paid completed order allows another review of same provider
Review eligibility: duplicate order and foreign customer order are rejected
Review eligibility: unfinished and unpaid services never qualify
Review eligibility: provider cannot review own order or legacy service
Two independent review submissions create exactly one row and exact aggregates
Historical source-less review survives and cannot be duplicated by guessing a source
New commerce service after a historical source-less review can still be reviewed
Public review cards reveal no customer, order, request or private source ids
Moderation deletion refreshes rating/count, including the last review
Profile schedule and slots share real hours; operational counts keep overdue work
Paid payment without processor item transaction remains unconfirmed
Uncertain checkout keeps a single initializer and is discoverable in the admin queue
Verified reconciliation can repair old missing item identity, but cannot change payment identity
Cancellation KPI includes paid cancelled service refunds without counting completed-service refunds
